slides.texte_overlay:
8 Signs you were meant for
an extraordinary life

You can't stop thinking
about what's possible.

Comfort bores you faster
than it used to.

People come to you
for advice.

You keep a list of things
you want to build.

You learn things nobody
asked you to learn.
slides.texte_sophia:
You learn things nobody asked you
to learn, on the Sophia app.

slides.texte_overlay:
You keep going when
no one notices.

You've been underestimated
before. And proved them wrong.

You still believe
your best years are ahead.
